verdict.rationale: FutureHouse's Literature agent explicitly searches 175M+ papers, trials, and patents with citation-graph and journal-quality awareness, and can perform deep literature reviews synthesizing evidence across hundreds of papers with cited, auditable outputs—clearly scholarly/primary-source search rather than open-web search. Documentation across both the cookbook and edisonscientific.com sites corroborates this consistently. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) verification of search quality/coverage claims.
